children: Belden Inc. (NYSE: BDC), a leading global provider of complete connection solutions, announces today that it will manufacture select RUCKUS Networks ICX Ethernet switches at its Pune, India facility. This signals an important step in the integration of RUCKUS, a Belden brand, into Belden through early initiatives focused on leveraging the combined company’s manufacturing, supply chain, commercial and operational capabilities to create value and accelerate growth.

The initiative extends RUCKUS’ significant existing presence in India into manufacturing while demonstrating how Belden can use its global operating footprint to support the RUCKUS portfolio and expand opportunities in key markets. The result is a more scalable local model that will better serve customers and partners.

“From the outset, our focus has been on bringing Belden and RUCKUS together in ways that create meaningful value for our customers and shareholders,” said Dr. Ashish Chand, President and CEO of Belden. “We are moving from integration planning to execution, identifying opportunities to leverage Belden’s global scale, operational capabilities and customer reach alongside RUCKUS’ strong technology portfolio and market position. Manufacturing the RUCKUS ICX Ethernet in India is an early example of that strategy in action, and we see additional opportunities to apply this approach as the integration progresses.”

Belden’s global manufacturing and operational footprint provides opportunities to integrate RUCKUS capabilities into existing infrastructure rather duplicating efforts. India provides an early example of this approach. RUCKUS has an established presence in Bengaluru, its largest global site for R&D and customer success, as well as a Research & Design Centre in Chennai. Belden also operates a Customer Innovation Center in Bengaluru and manufacturing capabilities in Pune. By bringing RUCKUS production into Belden’s operations, the combined company is creating a more connected presence across innovation, customer engagement and manufacturing. The initiative also supports India’s broader Make in India agenda, which encourages increased domestic manufacturing and domestic value addition. Local production strengthens RUCKUS’ ability to serve customers and partners in sectors where locally manufactured and supported technology infrastructure is increasingly important.

Manufacturing integration represents one component of Belden’s broader RUCKUS strategy. The combination of Belden and RUCKUS will improve operating efficiency through the leverage of common infrastructure and capabilities, while accelerating growth through deeper customer relationships, expanded market access and a broader portfolio of networking and connectivity solutions.

“Value realization is ultimately about taking the capabilities we now have across the combined organization and putting them to work,” Dr. Chand said. “That means looking across our enterprise business and our technology portfolio and identifying where bringing those capabilities together can improve how we operate, strengthen how we serve customers and create new avenues for growth.”

The India manufacturing initiative represents an early milestone in Belden’s ongoing integration of RUCKUS. Belden will continue to evaluate opportunities across its global operations and commercial organization to deliver practical value to its customers and partners.
